articles.title: Jeff Bezos says he was ‘heavily involved’ in picking the new James Bond
articles.essence: Robert Pattinson's casting as James Bond made enough sense given his recent work with director Denis Villeneuve, who's making the franchise's next film over at Amazon. But it turns out that Amazon founder Jeff Bezos played a significant role in making the final decision, too.
